messages:
maria: Pitched a new option today: switch org view from 3-column cards to a left-rail + compact list for quick scanning. Goal: keep invoice CTA obvious and make mobile fall back to a single list with per-item controls. Figma: https://figma.com/... :satellite: jonah: left-rail could be cleaner for discovery but risk of the right rail (detail) feeling detached. How do we keep the "Download invoice" action discoverable when the viewport is narrow? tess: idea: sticky header with scope name + month picker + primary CTA. On mobile collapse to an overflow menu per item (kebab) with "Download CSV". Keeps header minimal. rebecca: perf: returning tiny sparklines + totals for the list is fine. Do NOT fetch histograms for all org items by default. Plan: /usage/org?view=rail returns aggregated totals + sparkline. detail endpoint /projects/:id/usage-days paginates. sam-a11y: accessibility items: header CTA must be in tab order immediately after skiplinks. Per-item kebab menus need accessible labels e.g. aria-label="More options for ". For colorblind users avoid color-only delta indicators; add up/down glyphs and patterns. Also ensure month picker is keyboard operable with aria-activedescendant quirk. leah: CS feedback: customers often miss invoice when scope auto-switches. Strong preference for a header CTA that updates with scope + a subtle per-item "CSV" link. Copy: "Download invoice (CSV, YYYY-MM)". Add hint in scope breadcrumb about where to find it. noah-analytics: analytics: use event invoice_download with props {scope_type, scope_id, project_id|null, timeframe, source: header|item}. Dedupe logic: only count one download per user action; header set project_id=null. jonah: visual: for rail view show project name, cost (bold), tokens (muted) and delta pill. For contrast we should use icon+color. Delta tooltip: "Compared to previous period". Reduce vertical padding to 8px to fit more rows. rebecca: implement prefetch triggers: keyboard focus on row, intersection-observer 180px, or explicit "Show details" click. Add response header X-Estimated-Count so client chooses flyout vs inline table. sam-a11y: example ARIA live snippet for expand/collapse: ```html
Project tokens expanded for Project X
``` Ensure the string is concise. tess: mobile UX: on small screens replace pills with compact badges and move CSV action into an item overflow. Also consider haptic feedback for native apps. maria: decision: we're going to prototype rail + sticky header CTA. Gate behind feature flag `usage_rail_experiment` at 2% of orgs. Key metrics: invoice download CTR, avg projects seen, page TTI, support contacts about missing invoices. design-bot: deploy checklist: add feature flag usage_rail_experiment, ensure month-picker accessible keyboard nav, include fallback for reduced-motion prefs. rebecca: timeline: I'll stub the lightweight org endpoint this week. Will add ?prefetch=focus and X-Estimated-Count. Also will return sparklines as compressed SVG data URLs to keep payload small. noah-analytics: I'll add the event spec and dashboard for the experiment. Please include source prop in the click event. maria: thanks team. If nobody objects I'll lock the prototype requirements by EOD and ask design + eng to sync on keyboard flows tomorrow. :rocket:
